email.subject: Pulse Co Fitness site: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I took a look at Pulse Co Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no mobile-friendly layout, so anyone checking class times on their phone (most people) gets a clunky experience and probably leaves; and there's no way to book a class online, so interested people have to call during business hours or just give up. I also noticed there are no reviews shown, which makes new visitors less sure about trying you out.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
